title: Disney Magical Moments Pin Movie Poster Series Lady and The Tramp With Box
categoryName: Collectibles:Disneyana:Contemporary (1968-Now):Pins, Patches & Buttons:Other Disney Pins & Patches
descriptionText: The Disney Magical Moments Pin Movie Poster Series featuring Lady and The Tramp is a collectible item that captures the essence of the beloved Disney franchise. This pin showcases a classic scene from the movie, making it a must-have for fans and collectors alike. The inclusion of the original box adds to its charm, preserving the nostalgia and magic of Disney's iconic tale of love and adventure.
